attempts.text:
BANGARI SRIKANTH 

Email: bangarusrikanth@gmail.com 

Mobile: 9885823338 

 

Career Objective: 

Progressive professional with 10+ years of experience, offering extensive experience in handling 
and executing different payroll operations, ensure smooth service delivery. Currently seeking an 
environment where my knowledge can be shared and enriched to utilize my knowledge in 
enhancing company profitability. 

Work Experience: 

KFINTECH PVT LTD, Hyderabad                                                    20 April 2022 - Till date  

Assistant Manager (Axis Mutual Funds) 

 

• Generating Weekly and Monthly report and sending the reports to client. 
• Manage team standardization with Quality Control (QC) to close the feedback loop on 

quality checked records and make corrections. 
• Perform day to day management of Off-boarding Analysts and Reviewers, including 

training and providing ongoing performance feedback to team the team members. 
• Responsible for final quality check for the payment queue and releasing the payments as 

per the pre-decided NPCI service and share the data To Central Processing team 
• Meeting frequently with the client and interpret feedback regarding the quality of servicing 

and the areas of improvements. 
• Prepared the Monthly, Quarterly and Half yearly Dash boards and publish the same to 

management for reviewing. 

• Work closely with Partners and Directors and help them in decision making process by 
collecting, Analyze and enhance relevant data. 

• Record the dissatisfaction or complaints of the individual professional and report them to 
the director of compliance and ethics. 

• Closely work with the ethics team to bring the awareness among the professionals about 
the ethical quotient. Coordinate with External stakeholders for process update and change 
in process for implement with immediate effect. 

• Investigate, analyse and identify KYC issues which may lead to filing suspicious activity 
reports as Manage and make independent decisions regarding day-to-day team work, 
queue prioritization, escalations, and fraud/risk incidents, etc. 

• Maintain Daily weekly and monthly management reports of departmental activity volumes, 
drivers and key performance metrics; monitor and communicate overall status, key metrics 
and immediate concerns both to the team and management. 

• Identify gaps in process and work closely with compliance, product teams to develop 
creative solutions. 

• Selection, performance management, and overall development of employees within their 
assigned team. 

 

 
 

mailto:bangarusrikanth@gmail.com


ADP Private Ltd, Hyderabad                                                    11 April 2011 - 18 March 2021  

Analyst 

 

 Working in managed payroll services (US Payroll)  

 

• Processing of end-to-end payroll as per the SOP in Citrix enterprise. 

• Worked on HCM platforms like Enterprise EV4 & EV5, Vantage and Payforce. 

• Processing payroll with all the frequency like weekly, bi-weekly, semimonthly and monthly  

• Making adjustments to the tax panel and updating the employee marital and lived in, worked 
in status if required 

• Retro calculation for taxes and issue the salaries on prorated basis. 

• Processing acceleratory payroll and issue of live check on the pay date. 

•  Working on workday files which consists Personnel changes of the employees  

• Calculating the Social Security and Medicare taxes and refund if excess is deducted. 

• Work on Error Correction Notice (ECN), Drop pay, SIT/SUI reports during payroll to correct the 
errors and issue accurate pay 

• Preparing Variance manually by comparing last payroll with current payroll and explain the 
client about the difference in IBPM application and record them. 

• Processing of adjustment payroll as per client request to pay Bonus or Shares if any. 

• Issue manual checks if EE is dropped in payroll or if any adjustment is not paid. 

• Raising Direct Deposit Reversal or Stop payment request if EE is paid twice to stop 2nd check. 

• Client specific reports like Multi-jurisdiction, Stat summary, payroll register, payroll audit and 
Unused deduction report are downloaded and send for client review. 

• Updating Payroll metrics and incident logs to the client. 

• Work on SR’s and closing them within TAT. 

• Work on year end and quarter end activities like balancing W2 of the employee. 

 

 

Education Qualifications: 

• B. Com (computers) from Osmania University 

 

Personal Details: 

Father’s Name : B. Mallaiah  

Date of Birth : 27-08-1983 
Marital Status : Married 
Language : English, Telugu and Hindi. 

 


	BANGARI SRIKANTH
	Mobile: 9885823338
	Work Experience:
	Education Qualifications:
	Personal Details:
